build_identity.desktop: Windows interactive RDP session (xfreerdp3 client), 1600x1000, 96 DPI unless stated

actions: Real Explorer file and WordPad text drags onto all policy regions; .NET OLE drag source: mixed, URL text, 1.1 MB text, 1024/1025 files, odd paths, delayed rendering with receiver replacement/policy change/document replacement/window close
expected: Opt-in drops choose nearest eligible target; rejected regions; no retargeting
observed: Files only to dz-files/dz-both, text only to text-eligible zones; none/disabled/inert/plain reject; 1.1 MB and 1025 files rejected with errors; delayed data is read only at drop (fixed winit-win32 patch) and delivered to the target frozen at drop time
limitations: OLE delivers delayed-render data synchronously inside Drop, so the app cannot mutate the page between drop and data arrival; the drop always goes to the element under the pointer at release
